body: ac-06 satisfied: v0.6.22 tagged at 4909d88. Both release.yml (binary, 5 platforms incl Windows) and MainDistributionPipeline (extension, 5 platforms) green on the tag. GitHub release live with 10 assets; Homebrew + install site dispatched. Recovery of failed v0.6.21 complete (model drift -> v19 revert; Windows binary -> train feature-gated; Windows extension -> vendored openssl scoped to non-Windows). Dead v0.6.21 tag deleted local+remote.

ac-07 satisfied: community-extensions PR #2001 opened (duckdb/community-extensions) updating extensions/finetype/description.yml — repo.github→meridian-online/finetype, ref→v0.6.22, version 0.2.0→0.6.22, 250→240 types, drop python3 toolchain, docs refreshed with verified examples + real finetype_detail shape + finetype_validate documented + per-value-context caveat. Issue #3 reply posted by author. Findings surfaced: per-value finetype() misfires on values needing column context (bare UUID→isbn, phone→isbn, placeholder email→plain_text) — known model property, not a regression; finetype_validate silently ignores JSON-Schema 'format' (generic jsonschema checker). ac-08 (HTTP 200 after merge) + ac-09 (archive standalone) + ac-10 (revert docs) remain.

ac-07/PR #2001: first CI run failed only on windows_amd64_mingw — link.exe cannot resolve MinGW runtime symbols (___chkstk_ms, __mingw_vsnprintf, pthread_*) from aws-lc-sys (crypto via hf-hub runtime model download) and onig_sys (tokenizers regex). All other platforms green (Linux x64/arm64, macOS x86/arm, Windows MSVC). Fix: added windows_amd64_mingw to excluded_platforms (commit 944d5b1 on the PR branch). MSVC windows_amd64 still ships, so Windows coverage stands. Supporting mingw = drop onig + swap TLS off aws-lc, deferred.
